newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Disabled Australian girl awarded A$2 million damages.
newsitem.headline: Disabled Australian girl awarded A$2 million damages.

text.p: A 15-year-old disabled Australian girl, who sued her father over injuries she suffered in a car accident when she was a baby, was on Friday awarded A$2.2 million (US$1.6 million).
Pinar Gulasi, nine-months-old when the family car collided with another vehicle in 1982, suffered brain damage in the accident and sued the driver -- her father, Shane Gulasi.
New South Wales state supreme court judge Carolyn Simpson said she awarded Gulasi the damages to compensate for her intellectual impairment.
"She will be deprived of the satisfaction of employment and of earning her own living and adopting and maintaining an independent lifestyle," Simpson found.
"She will probably never experience marriage, children, or family life as an adult."
